original_question: Which chromosome is affected by mutations in the recessive lysosomal storage disease described first by Emil Abderhalden?

final_qi.question: Which chromosome is affected by mutations in the recessive lysosomal storage disease described first by Emil Abderhalden?
final_qi.long_answer: Emil Abderhalden first described cystinosis (also called Abderhalden-Lignac syndrome), an autosomal-recessive lysosomal storage disease in which cystine accumulates within lysosomes. The disease is caused by loss-of-function mutations in the CTNS gene that encodes the lysosomal cystine transporter cystinosin. CTNS is situated on chromosome 17p13, so chromosome 17 is the chromosome affected by the pathogenic mutations.
